sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, edited historical source PDF (official modern compilation)
sources.quality_notes: Directly viewed PDF index page178/print page116, cites Seungjeongwon Ilgi 1867 lunar 7/11, proposes two-volume Seontaek Giyo to replace Yuan Tiangang exam and records 允. PDF typesets 滑吉; separate Wikisource received page typesets 涓吉, not resolved as an original glyph. Edited official PDF is not a physical 1867 original, and approval is not class roster or original book printing. Normalized technical registry status tag: NIKH official edited PDF leaf was visually checked but original Joseon leaf remains unreviewed; do not interpret this enum as physical-glyph verification.

sources.title: 《高宗實錄》卷11 1874二月二十八日李裕元命課學試書復舊奏議
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Joseon Veritable Records official Hanmun received text
sources.quality_notes: The minister reports recent formal exam book Seontaek Giyo and requested restoration of earlier Yuan Tiangang books. The monarch says concern understandable, not expressly 允/復舊. Adjacent unrelated royal 允 to restore other policies cannot be transferred to this matter. Original folio not separately reviewed.
